frame: vehicle frame B (the vehicle's own frame, configuration `mission`), millimetres: x forward, y to port, z up. Every part BREP, centre, bound, feature point and every local_to_world matrix is in this frame. Module frames: each purchased type's own frame, defined by its geometry (purchased.<type>.frame); the vendor STEP in the payload is written in it

BALLAST.name: ballast weight, stainless steel
BALLAST.frame: origin on the mounting hole's axis in the mating face (the flat face opposite the opening of the conical hole); +z normal to the mating face, pointing into the block; +x along the long edges; y = z x x

BATTERY.name: battery enclosure, 3-inch acrylic tube, with battery pack
BATTERY.frame: origin on the tube axis in the outer end face of the ported end cap; +z along the axis towards the blind end cap; +x from the axis towards the port that holds the pressure-relief valve; y = z x x

DVL.name: Doppler velocity log, four beams
DVL.frame: origin at the centre of the transducer face (the flat centre of the four-beam face, on the housing axis); +z the outward normal of that face; +x from the axis towards the indicator light; y = z x x

ENCLOSURE.name: electronics enclosure, 4-inch acrylic tube with dome
ENCLOSURE.frame: origin on the tube axis in the outer end face of the ported end cap; +z along the axis towards the dome; +x from the axis towards the port that holds the pressure-relief valve; y = z x x

GRIPPER.name: single-axis gripper
GRIPPER.frame: origin at the centre of the housing's rear end face (on the housing axis); +x along the housing axis towards the jaw tips; +z perpendicular to the axis and to the jaw pivot pins (the direction the jaws open and close), on the side of the cable penetrator in the rear cap; y = z x x

LIGHT.name: LED light, 1500 lm
LIGHT.frame: origin midway between the two M3 mounting bores in the mounting face; +x the direction the light leaves the lens; +z normal to the mounting face, pointing out of the light; y = z x x

THRUSTER-CCW.name: ducted thruster, counter-clockwise propeller
THRUSTER-CCW.frame: origin on the propeller axis at the axial position of the centre of the 4 x M3 mounting bores; +z along the propeller axis from the nose cone end to the duct exit; -y from the axis towards the mounting face (the bores' open ends); x = y x z

THRUSTER-CW.name: ducted thruster, clockwise propeller
THRUSTER-CW.frame: origin on the propeller axis at the axial position of the centre of the 4 x M3 mounting bores; +z along the propeller axis from the nose cone end to the duct exit; -y from the axis towards the mounting face (the bores' open ends); x = y x z

mass_properties.method: made parts: exact B-rep volume x material density; purchased: datasheet mass spread over the module's solids by volume (uniform density per module), as grade.py computes it

conventions.features: the UAV task's feature extraction, unchanged, r_min 0.5 mm, no upper radius limit: a feature is a chain of coaxial concave faces touching along the axis with at least one cylindrical step; hole = every cylindrical step covers >= 300 deg, partial = at least one >= 175 deg. Conical steps are not written (none is scored); radius_mm = the first cylindrical step from the opening; point_mm = the axis point at the opening, dir = into the material, depth_mm = the whole chain's axial length (cones included); ids <tag>.Hnn / <tag>.Unn in the extractor's order (holes first, by decreasing radius, then position)
conventions.families: every instance of a family is the family's first instance under a proper rigid motion: invariants (volume, area, principal moments) within 1e-4 and exact registration (B-rep vertex sets, then exact surfaces) within 0.02 mm, determinant +1
conventions.anchors: the anchor's congruence class (grade.Reference._classes: same vertex count, volume within 1e-6, grade.register_exact within recognition.exact_tol_mm) has exactly one member over all 545 constituents; thrusters: the propeller (the only solid of a hand without a congruent solid in the other hand)
conventions.supports: for every owner (part tag or placement id): the owners whose exact B-rep distance to it is <= 0.1 mm (distances exact up to 1 mm); grade.py uses the placements' lists
conventions.rotors: one flow body per thruster placement: a cylinder on the module's z axis (the propeller axis of the module frame; axis_point_mm = the module origin, axis_dir = the module +z, nose cone to duct exit), disc_radius_mm = the propeller's exact largest distance from that axis, axial range = the module's exact z extent with 10 mm added at the nose-cone end (-z) and 25 mm at the duct-exit end (+z); prop and prop_type are null (no propeller instance); the reference's own overlap is computed by grade.py itself, the exact value is listed for information
conventions.interference: common volume > 0.01 mm^3 of two solids of different owners: exact checked booleans (with the solids' tolerances capped), cross-checked on the grader's tessellations (grade.mesh_solid, grade.common_volume); where the boolean fails or disagrees by more than max(5 mm^3, 10 %) the tessellation's value is used (solids[][3] says which); grade.py computes its own on its tessellations; overlaps inside one purchased module are not listed (the module is imported unchanged; grade.py does not use them)
conventions.symmetry: nothing is declared per type (order 1, not continuous): grade.py measures orientation errors by registration onto the reference module; module_self_registrations lists the module's proper exact self-maps for information
conventions.features_withdrawn: features listed here are reference features taken out of scoring before the freeze because no photograph shows them readably (the black-part rule of the photo set; `rule` says which part of it); the geometry of their parts is unchanged and the records are the extractor's, moved here unchanged; the grader scores parts.<tag>.features only
